scope.note: HODIE estimates functional progress; it does not provide official CEFR certification.

philosophy: Can-Do -> Try -> Evidence -> Gap -> Practice -> Retry -> Master

confidenceScale.label: I could do it with a lot of help.
I could do it with some help.
I could do it by myself.

canDos.canDo: I can introduce myself and give basic personal information.
canDos.spanish: Puedo presentarme y dar información personal básica.

evidence.task: Give a short personal introduction.

canDos.canDo: I can talk about my family.
canDos.spanish: Puedo hablar sobre mi familia.

evidence.task: Describe your family.

canDos.canDo: I can describe my daily routine.
canDos.spanish: Puedo describir mi rutina diaria.

evidence.task: Describe a normal weekday.

canDos.canDo: I can talk about my likes and dislikes.
canDos.spanish: Puedo hablar de mis gustos y preferencias.

evidence.task: Talk about things you like and dislike.

canDos.canDo: I can describe a familiar person.
canDos.spanish: Puedo describir a una persona conocida.

evidence.task: Describe someone you know.

canDos.canDo: I can describe a familiar place.
canDos.spanish: Puedo describir un lugar conocido.

evidence.task: Describe your home, school or neighborhood.

canDos.canDo: I can answer simple questions about myself.
canDos.spanish: Puedo responder preguntas sencillas sobre mí.

evidence.task: Answer five basic questions about yourself.

canDos.canDo: I can talk about what I am doing now.
canDos.spanish: Puedo hablar de lo que estoy haciendo ahora.

evidence.task: Describe what is happening around you now.

canDos.canDo: I can talk about what I did yesterday.
canDos.spanish: Puedo hablar de lo que hice ayer.

evidence.task: Describe what you did yesterday.

canDos.spanish: Puedo hablar de planes futuros.

evidence.task: Describe your plans for next week.

canDos.canDo: I can describe a past experience.
canDos.spanish: Puedo describir una experiencia pasada.

evidence.task: Tell a short story about an experience.

canDos.canDo: I can explain my job in simple English.
canDos.spanish: Puedo explicar mi trabajo en inglés sencillo.

evidence.task: Explain what you do at work.

canDos.canDo: I can describe a project I am working on.
canDos.spanish: Puedo describir un proyecto en el que estoy trabajando.

evidence.task: Describe a current project.

canDos.canDo: I can explain a simple process.
canDos.spanish: Puedo explicar un proceso sencillo.

evidence.task: Explain a familiar process in 3–5 steps.

canDos.canDo: I can give a simple opinion.
canDos.spanish: Puedo expresar una opinión sencilla.

evidence.task: Give an opinion and one reason.

canDos.canDo: I can ask someone for clarification.
canDos.spanish: Puedo pedir aclaración cuando no entiendo.

evidence.task: Use two clarification strategies in a role-play.

canDos.canDo: I can talk about my work and responsibilities.
canDos.spanish: Puedo hablar sobre mi trabajo y responsabilidades.

evidence.task: Explain your role, responsibilities and typical tasks.

canDos.canDo: I can describe professional experiences.
canDos.spanish: Puedo describir experiencias profesionales.

evidence.task: Describe your professional experience and give specific examples.

canDos.canDo: I can explain a project I have completed.
canDos.spanish: Puedo explicar un proyecto que he terminado.

evidence.task: Explain a completed project: context, actions and result.

canDos.canDo: I can express and justify my opinion.
canDos.spanish: Puedo expresar y justificar mi opinión.

evidence.task: Give an opinion, two reasons and a contrasting point.

canDos.canDo: I can describe a problem.
canDos.spanish: Puedo describir un problema.

evidence.task: Describe a familiar problem and its context.

canDos.canDo: I can suggest a solution.
canDos.spanish: Puedo proponer una solución.

evidence.task: Suggest a solution and explain why it could work.

canDos.canDo: I can compare two options.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comparar dos opciones.

evidence.task: Compare two options and make a recommendation.

canDos.canDo: I can explain my plans and goals.
canDos.spanish: Puedo explicar mis planes y metas.

evidence.task: Describe your goals, plans and reasons.

canDos.canDo: I can talk about something I have learned.
canDos.spanish: Puedo hablar sobre algo que he aprendido.

canDos.canDo: I can participate in a conversation on a familiar topic.
canDos.spanish: Puedo participar en una conversación sobre un tema familiar.

canDos.canDo: I can tell a story with a clear sequence.
canDos.spanish: Puedo contar una historia con una secuencia clara.

canDos.canDo: I can speak about a familiar topic for several minutes.
canDos.spanish: Puedo hablar sobre un tema familiar durante varios minutos.

canDos.canDo: I can understand basic personal information.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender información personal básica.

canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender números, fechas y horas.

canDos.spanish: Puedo identificar el tema principal de una conversación corta.

canDos.canDo: I can understand simple instructions.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender instrucciones sencillas.

evidence.task: Follow a sequence of simple instructions.

canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender preguntas familiares.

evidence.task: Listen to questions and identify what information is requested.

canDos.canDo: I can understand short descriptions.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender descripciones cortas.

evidence.task: Identify key facts from a short description.

canDos.canDo: I can understand the main idea of an everyday conversation.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender la idea principal de una conversación cotidiana.

evidence.task: Identify the main idea of an everyday conversation.

canDos.canDo: I can identify important details.
canDos.spanish: Puedo identificar detalles importantes.

evidence.task: Answer detail questions after listening.

canDos.canDo: I can understand a short explanation about a familiar topic.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender una explicación corta sobre un tema familiar.

evidence.task: Extract the main point and supporting details.

canDos.canDo: I can understand someone talking about a past experience.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender a alguien hablando de una experiencia pasada.

evidence.task: Identify who, what, when and outcome.

canDos.canDo: I can understand the main idea of normal speech on familiar topics.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender la idea principal del habla normal sobre temas familiares.

canDos.canDo: I can identify relevant details in a conversation.
canDos.spanish: Puedo identificar detalles relevantes en una conversación.

evidence.task: Extract relevant details from a conversation.

canDos.canDo: I can understand a short interview.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender una entrevista corta.

evidence.task: Identify topic, answers and key details from an interview.

canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender explicaciones sobre temas profesionales familiares.

canDos.canDo: I can understand simple opinions.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender opiniones sencillas.

evidence.task: Identify an opinion and a supporting reason.

canDos.canDo: I can follow a short story.
canDos.spanish: Puedo seguir una historia corta.

evidence.task: Reconstruct the sequence of a short story.

canDos.canDo: I can understand the speaker's basic intention.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender la intención básica del hablante.

canDos.spanish: Puedo seguir una conversación aunque no entienda todas las palabras.

canDos.canDo: I can understand short messages.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender mensajes cortos.

evidence.task: Read a short message and answer functional questions.

canDos.canDo: I can understand simple instructions.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender instrucciones sencillas.

evidence.task: Identify actions and sequence in instructions.

canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender horarios y cronogramas.

evidence.task: Find dates, times and events in a schedule.

canDos.canDo: I can understand simple advertisements.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender anuncios sencillos.

evidence.task: Identify product, price, time and basic conditions.

canDos.canDo: I can understand short personal descriptions.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender descripciones personales cortas.

evidence.task: Identify key information in a personal profile.

canDos.canDo: I can understand a short text about someone's experience.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender un texto corto sobre la experiencia de alguien.

evidence.task: Identify main idea, events and outcome.

canDos.canDo: I can understand a simple professional message.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender un mensaje profesional sencillo.

evidence.task: Identify the sender's purpose, request and deadline.

canDos.canDo: I can follow simple technical instructions.
canDos.spanish: Puedo seguir instrucciones técnicas sencillas.

evidence.task: Identify the correct sequence in a simple technical procedure.

canDos.canDo: I can understand the main idea of a short article.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender la idea principal de un artículo corto.

evidence.task: Read a short article and identify the main idea.

canDos.canDo: I can find specific information in a text.
canDos.spanish: Puedo encontrar información específica en un texto.

evidence.task: Locate specific facts efficiently.

canDos.canDo: I can understand emails about familiar topics.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender correos sobre temas familiares.

evidence.task: Identify purpose, tone, request and relevant details.

canDos.canDo: I can understand simple professional documentation.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender documentación profesional sencilla.

evidence.task: Extract requirements, steps and warnings.

canDos.canDo: I can understand someone's opinion in a text.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender la opinión de alguien en un texto.

evidence.task: Identify opinion and supporting argument.

canDos.spanish: Puedo inferir el significado de una palabra desconocida por el contexto.

canDos.canDo: I can understand connected texts about familiar subjects.
canDos.spanish: Puedo comprender textos conectados sobre temas familiares.

canDos.canDo: I can write basic personal information.
canDos.spanish: Puedo escribir información personal básica.

evidence.task: Complete a short profile.

canDos.canDo: I can write simple sentences about my routine.
canDos.spanish: Puedo escribir frases sencillas sobre mi rutina.

evidence.task: Write about a normal day.

canDos.canDo: I can write a short message.
canDos.spanish: Puedo escribir un mensaje corto.

evidence.task: Write a functional message to another person.

canDos.canDo: I can describe a person.
canDos.spanish: Puedo describir una persona.

evidence.task: Describe someone you know.

canDos.canDo: I can describe a place.
canDos.spanish: Puedo describir un lugar.

evidence.task: Describe a familiar place.

canDos.canDo: I can describe something that happened.
canDos.spanish: Puedo describir algo que ocurrió.

evidence.task: Describe a past event.

canDos.spanish: Puedo escribir sobre mis planes.

canDos.spanish: Puedo expresar una opinión sencilla por escrito.

evidence.task: Give an opinion and at least one reason.

canDos.spanish: Puedo escribir un correo informal.

canDos.canDo: I can write a professional message.
canDos.spanish: Puedo escribir un mensaje profesional.

evidence.task: Write a clear professional request, update or response.

canDos.canDo: I can describe a project.
canDos.spanish: Puedo describir un proyecto.

evidence.task: Describe a project: context, actions and result.

canDos.canDo: I can explain a simple process.
canDos.spanish: Puedo explicar un proceso sencillo por escrito.

evidence.task: Explain a familiar process step by step.

canDos.canDo: I can describe a past experience.
canDos.spanish: Puedo describir una experiencia pasada.

evidence.task: Describe a meaningful experience.

canDos.canDo: I can express and justify an opinion.
canDos.spanish: Puedo expresar y justificar una opinión por escrito.

evidence.task: Give an opinion, reasons and a contrasting point.

canDos.canDo: I can connect ideas into a coherent text.
canDos.spanish: Puedo conectar ideas en un texto coherente.

evidence.task: Write a short connected text with a clear beginning, development and conclusion.

canDos.canDo: I can use vocabulary about myself and my family.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar vocabulario sobre mí y mi familia.

evidence.task: Use target words in short spoken or written sentences.

canDos.canDo: I can use vocabulary about daily routines.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar vocabulario sobre rutinas diarias.

evidence.task: Use routine vocabulary in context.

canDos.canDo: I can talk about food, places and activities.
canDos.spanish: Puedo hablar de comida, lugares y actividades.

evidence.task: Produce short context-rich sentences.

canDos.canDo: I can use common time expressions.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar expresiones comunes de tiempo.

evidence.task: Use time expressions accurately in context.

canDos.canDo: I can describe people and places using adjectives.
canDos.spanish: Puedo describir personas y lugares usando adjetivos.

evidence.task: Use at least 8 target adjectives meaningfully.

canDos.canDo: I can talk about work using basic vocabulary.
canDos.spanish: Puedo hablar del trabajo usando vocabulario básico.

canDos.spanish: Puedo usar verbos comunes para la comunicación cotidiana.

canDos.canDo: I can use vocabulary related to my profession.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar vocabulario relacionado con mi profesión.

canDos.spanish: Puedo explicar conceptos técnicos familiares en inglés sencillo.

canDos.canDo: I can use common connectors to organize ideas.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar conectores comunes para organizar ideas.

canDos.spanish: Puedo explicar una idea con otras palabras cuando no conozco una palabra.

canDos.canDo: I can use vocabulary without translating every word mentally.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar vocabulario sin traducir mentalmente cada palabra.

canDos.canDo: I can ask basic questions.
canDos.spanish: Puedo hacer preguntas básicas.

evidence.task: Ask five relevant basic questions.

canDos.canDo: I can answer basic questions.
canDos.spanish: Puedo responder preguntas básicas.

evidence.task: Answer five basic questions with relevant information.

canDos.canDo: I can ask someone to repeat something.
canDos.spanish: Puedo pedirle a alguien que repita algo.

evidence.task: Use at least two natural repetition requests.

canDos.canDo: I can say that I don't understand.
canDos.spanish: Puedo decir que no entiendo.

evidence.task: Use a repair phrase appropriately in role-play.

canDos.canDo: I can ask for clarification.
canDos.spanish: Puedo pedir una aclaración.

evidence.task: Ask for clarification in two different situations.

canDos.canDo: I can keep a short conversation going.
canDos.spanish: Puedo mantener una conversación corta.

evidence.task: Sustain a short familiar-topic exchange.

canDos.canDo: I can ask follow-up questions.
canDos.spanish: Puedo hacer preguntas de seguimiento.

evidence.task: Ask relevant follow-up questions based on the other person's answers.

canDos.canDo: I can react to what another person says.
canDos.spanish: Puedo reaccionar a lo que dice otra persona.

evidence.task: Respond meaningfully instead of only answering questions.

canDos.canDo: I can change the subject naturally.
canDos.spanish: Puedo cambiar de tema de forma natural.

evidence.task: Move from one familiar topic to another appropriately.

canDos.canDo: I can explain something when I don't know the exact word.
canDos.spanish: Puedo explicar algo cuando no conozco la palabra exacta.

evidence.task: Describe three blocked concepts without using the target word.

canDos.canDo: I can disagree politely.
canDos.spanish: Puedo estar en desacuerdo de forma educada.

evidence.task: Disagree, give a reason and maintain a respectful tone.

canDos.canDo: I can maintain a conversation even when I make mistakes.
canDos.spanish: Puedo mantener una conversación aunque cometa errores.

canDos.canDo: I can use be to identify and describe.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar be para identificar y describir.

canDos.canDo: I can use have to talk about possession and information.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar have para hablar de posesión e información.

canDos.spanish: Puedo usar Present Simple para rutinas y hechos.

canDos.canDo: I can use the Present Continuous for actions happening now.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar Present Continuous para acciones que ocurren ahora.

evidence.task: Describe current actions.

canDos.canDo: I can use there is/are to describe places.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar there is/are para describir lugares.

evidence.task: Describe a familiar place.

canDos.canDo: I can use can and can't to talk about ability and possibility.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar can y can't para habilidad y posibilidad.

evidence.task: State abilities and simple possibilities.

canDos.canDo: I can use the Past Simple to talk about finished events.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar Past Simple para eventos terminados.

evidence.task: Tell what happened yesterday or in a past event.

canDos.canDo: I can use going to to talk about plans.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar going to para hablar de planes.

evidence.task: Talk about future plans.

canDos.canDo: I can use comparatives to compare things.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar comparativos para comparar cosas.

evidence.task: Compare two familiar options.

canDos.canDo: I can form basic questions.
canDos.spanish: Puedo formar preguntas básicas.

evidence.task: Form and ask relevant questions.

canDos.canDo: I can use frequency adverbs to describe routines.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar adverbios de frecuencia para describir rutinas.

evidence.task: Describe routine frequency accurately.

canDos.canDo: I can use common prepositions of place and time.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar preposiciones comunes de lugar y tiempo.

evidence.task: Describe location and time accurately.

canDos.canDo: I can connect simple ideas.
canDos.spanish: Puedo conectar ideas sencillas.

evidence.task: Combine short ideas using basic connectors.

canDos.canDo: I can use the Present Perfect to talk about experiences.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar Present Perfect para hablar de experiencias.

evidence.task: Describe life and professional experiences.

canDos.canDo: I can choose between Present Perfect and Past Simple.
canDos.spanish: Puedo elegir entre Present Perfect y Past Simple.

evidence.task: Contrast ongoing experience with finished past events.

canDos.canDo: I can use common future forms to talk about plans and predictions.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar formas comunes de futuro para planes y predicciones.

evidence.task: Discuss plans and predictions in context.

canDos.canDo: I can use modal verbs to give advice and express possibility.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar verbos modales para dar consejos y expresar posibilidad.

evidence.task: Give advice and alternatives.

canDos.canDo: I can use the First Conditional for real possibilities.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar First Conditional para posibilidades reales.

evidence.task: Discuss realistic if/then situations.

canDos.canDo: I can use relative clauses to add information.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar oraciones relativas para agregar información.

evidence.task: Combine ideas using who/that/which.

canDos.canDo: I can use because, although, however and so to connect ideas.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar conectores para relacionar ideas.

evidence.task: Build coherent spoken and written responses with contrast and cause.

canDos.canDo: I can use the Past Continuous to give background information.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar Past Continuous para dar contexto en una narración.

evidence.task: Tell a story using background and interrupted events.

canDos.canDo: I can use common gerund and infinitive patterns.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar patrones comunes con gerundio e infinitivo.

canDos.canDo: I can use basic passive forms to describe processes.
canDos.spanish: Puedo usar la voz pasiva básica para describir procesos.

evidence.task: Describe how a familiar product or process works.

metaCanDos.canDo: I can talk about my work, experiences, opinions and plans for 3–5 minutes without relying heavily on translation.
I can understand the main idea and important details of normal conversations about familiar topics.
I can read everyday and professional texts and understand their main ideas and relevant details.
I can write a clear, connected message about familiar personal or professional topics.
